title: Erratum: hemisphere totals and strait transports still wear a whole-grid label
description: After reducing a sea-ice field to one hemisphere total or four strait values, the file still advertises the full tripolar grid g118. That describes the source mesh, not the output representation.
example: A catalogue or automated reader can see a global grid label while the data contain just one number per month or four named passages. This can break discovery and grid handling without changing the actual totals.
scientific_evidence: All 16 first-file headers retain g118/100 km, although hemispheric totals have only time and strait products have time × line. #827 identifies registered hemisphere grids g011/g012 and passage grid g014. The same passage-label issue extends to simassacrossline.
impact: Grid discovery, dataset identification and automated processing can misinterpret the representation. This finding alone does not show wrong integrated values.
recommended_action: Select the approved reduced grid labels consistently in metadata, filenames and DRS, then republish as new versions with a documented identifier migration. Keep the existing region and numerical values if separately validated.
development_team_action: MOPPy development: existing PR #830 addresses reduced sea-ice grids; validate its coverage of simassacrossline before opening competing work. Publication team: update metadata and DRS consistently in new versions. Keep the unresolved ocean native-row geometry separate (P03).
extent_statement: Complete file list within the identified release versions; numerical confirmation was sampled, not a scan of every value.
publication_action: No withdrawal, retraction, replacement or ESGF submission performed by this task.
